data.one_liner: Fetch Uint8List from a Uri without creating temporary files
data.what_it_does: This package reads bytes directly from a Uri and returns them as a Uint8List. It supports data, file, http, https and Android content schemes, and can stream large files in chunks.
use_when: Need to download binary data from a network or file Uri
Want to avoid temporary files on disk
Need custom headers or a mockable HTTP client
avoid_when: Fetching very large files with the from() method (use getContentStream instead)
strengths: No temp files, minimal disk usage
Supports multiple schemes including Android content URIs
weaknesses: from() can crash on large files if memory is insufficient
Requires Android permissions for content scheme (READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE)

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard HTTP client for simple GET requests, but lacks Uri extension and content scheme support

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Feature‑rich HTTP client with interceptors, but still creates temp files for downloads
